answer: This query finds public classes under the auto_ontology/connectors path that are used as base classes by other non-test classes and have no resolved inbound calls, so they are never constructed by a resolved call. For each qualifying base class, it counts the distinct non-test subclasses and returns the class symbol with that count.

question: Which public classes in auto_ontology/connectors are used only as base classes: subclassed by other non-test classes but never constructed by a resolved call? Give the number of non-test subclasses of each.
reference_sql:
SELECT s.symbol_id, COUNT(DISTINCT b.class_symbol_id) AS subclasses
FROM code.symbols s
JOIN code.files f ON f.file_id = s.file_id
JOIN code.class_bases b ON b.base_symbol_id = s.symbol_id
JOIN code.symbols sub ON sub.symbol_id = b.class_symbol_id
JOIN code.files sf ON sf.file_id = sub.file_id
WHERE s.kind = 'class' AND s.is_public AND NOT f.is_test AND NOT sf.is_test
  AND f.file_id LIKE 'auto_ontology/connectors/%'
  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM code.calls c WHERE c.callee_symbol_id = s.symbol_id AND c.call_kind = 'direct')
GROUP BY s.symbol_id
ORDER BY s.symbol_id;

request.evidence: code.class_bases records the base classes named in each class statement; base_symbol_id is the internal class a base resolves to. Calling a class name creates an instance.

sql: SELECT s.symbol_id AS symbol_id, CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT cb.class_symbol_id) AS INTEGER) AS subclasses FROM auto_ontology_code.code.symbols AS s INNER JOIN auto_ontology_code.code.class_bases AS cb ON cb.base_symbol_id = s.symbol_id INNER JOIN auto_ontology_code.code.symbols AS ssub ON cb.class_symbol_id = ssub.symbol_id INNER JOIN auto_ontology_code.code.files AS fsub ON ssub.file_id = fsub.file_id WHERE s.kind = 'class' AND s.is_public = TRUE AND s.file_id LIKE 'auto_ontology/connectors/%' AND fsub.is_test = FALSE AND cb.class_symbol_id <> s.symbol_id AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM auto_ontology_code.code.inbound_call_counts AS icc WHERE icc.symbol_id = s.symbol_id AND COALESCE(icc.inbound_calls, 0) > 0) GROUP BY s.symbol_id ORDER BY s.symbol_id
